scope: C-end discrimination and utterance-length readiness gates layered on top of the frozen v5 scientific promotion protocol

decision_semantics.pass: v5 scientific gates and v10 C-end discrimination gates pass; candidate may enter a separate score-changing A/B branch with a new ScoreContract
decision_semantics.fail: candidate must remain shadow; do not rescue by tuning on held data
decision_semantics.insufficient: collect more held learner/native/short/long criterion data before any score-changing branch

rationale.learner_only: overall native-plus-learner correlation can look good even when learner scores collapse into a narrow band
rationale.length_coverage: a C-end free-speaking score must remain useful for both short conversational turns and longer utterances
rationale.group_direction: native controls are a safety check, but the machine is required to follow the human criterion direction rather than assume native-likeness is the construct
rationale.no_new_score_mapping: these gates validate candidate behavior only; they do not alter ProductScore or fit a new mapping
